testcase.name: Supported magnitude: Vec3, Quat.rotate and Frame stay finite and homogeneous up to 1e100
Tier 1: Pose.toWorld overflows to infinity (no exception, no clamping); Frame.toWorld likewise
Tier 1: Vec3 and Quat overflow to infinity with no exception and no saturation
Supported magnitude: Pose with scale and translation up to 1e100 is finite and accurate; compositions of two stay finite
Tier 3: Pose.then throws ArithmeticException when scale overflows or underflows to zero; two valid poses never give an invalid one
Tier 1: NaN and infinity propagate by IEEE rules (no sanitizing, no exceptions)
Tier 3: Pose.inverse throws ArithmeticException when the reciprocal scale or inverse translation is not representable
Tier 2: Quat.normalized and inverse are total: finite unit result for every double input, IDENTITY for zero or non-finite
Tier 2: Frame factories always return a valid right-handed frame, WORLD for a degenerate axis, for every double input
Tier 3: constructors keep throwing IllegalArgumentException for invalid inputs
Tier 2: shortestArc is total: unit result for every pair; IDENTITY for degenerate input; correct mapping otherwise
Tier 2: normalizedOr is total: fallback exactly for degenerate input, otherwise a finite unit vector
Tier 3: Pose.then throws ArithmeticException when the composed translation overflows
